conditions.description: issue creates reset tokens by Base64-encoding user ID and expiry with no signature or secret.
conditions.rationale: A client can forge a token for another user by encoding a chosen user ID and timestamp.

conditions.description: consume trusts the expiry timestamp embedded in the unsigned client token.
conditions.rationale: Because the token is unauthenticated, a forged far-future expiry can bypass intended lifetime limits.

conditions.description: The unsafe token path has no persistence or revocation state and therefore does not enforce single use.
conditions.rationale: A captured reset token can be replayed until its embedded expiry.

conditions.description: The unsafe reset token directly encodes the account identifier in reversible Base64.
conditions.rationale: The token exposes internal user IDs and makes targeted forgery straightforward.

conditions.description: issue_safe generates a cryptographically random 32-byte-equivalent hex token and stores only its SHA-256 digest.
conditions.rationale: This is an explicit unpredictability/storage negative control and should not be reported as deterministic token generation.

conditions.description: consume_safe uses a consume-once store record and enforces the server-side expiry.
conditions.rationale: The safe control explicitly implements single-use and server-controlled lifetime semantics.

conditions.description: Whether reset links are transported only over authenticated TLS channels is not established by this module.
conditions.rationale: Transport security is an external deployment/property not shown in the fixture.

conditions.description: Whether additional identity verification or rate limiting protects the surrounding reset flow is not established.
conditions.rationale: The fixture contains token helpers but not the full account-recovery workflow.

conditions.description: The unsafe reset-token flow must not be cleared as tamper-resistant.
conditions.rationale: The account ID and expiry are unauthenticated client-controlled data.

conditions.description: The unsafe reset-token flow must not be cleared as single-use or replay-resistant.
conditions.rationale: No server-side consumption state exists in issue/consume.
